title: Warm Gooey Middle-Eastern Chestnut Tabbouleh
description: A hearty and comforting twist on traditional tabbouleh, featuring roasted chestnuts and a rich, gooey drizzle made with infused oil.

ingredients.name: Infused oil
ingredients.notes: sesame oil infused with garlic and thyme

instructions: Toss the chestnuts with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur, parsley, tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Add the roasted chestnuts to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and infused oil.
Pour the dressing over the tabbouleh and toss to combine.
Transfer the tabbouleh to a Dutch oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until heated through and the flavors have melded together.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the oven or microwave before serving.
